The '''Yyrtan system''' was located along a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that became popular during the period of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It contained the star [[Yyrta]] and was orbited by at least four planets, including [[Kirtania]], the homeworld of the [[Araquia]] species.<ref name="QM" />
